item.title: Pregnant Worker Fairness Act and other ways to support employee work-life balance — Thu Aug 27, 11:30 AM — Santa Rosa Dowtown Square
item.description: Habrá servicio de interpretación al español Join us for this free educational seminar open to all Sonoma County employers, business leaders, HR professionals, and managers. The first session of this three-part series explores the Pregnant Worker Fairness Act and practical strategies for supporting employees during pregnancy, after childbirth, and throughout the transition to parenthood. Presented by Samantha Pungprakearti, Associate, Carle, Mackie, Power & Ross LLP, the seminar combines expert employment legal reminders with discussion of innovative workplace practices that help employers attract, retain, and support talented employees through work-life balance initiatives. Participants will learn: What accommodations employers may be required to provide during pregnancy and after childbirth—and why those obligations are broader than many employers realize. The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Aug 30, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Rare Films Event "Capt Brightthorn & the Legion of Doom" — Sun Aug 30, 4:30 PM — Isis Oasis Sanctuary
item.description:
The Redwood Theater at Isis Oasis Sanctuary is inviting you to an afternoon premiere showing of two films that you are truly unlikely to see anywhere else. One is the work of independent filmmaker Tom Lux and was filmed at Isis Oasis itself - Commander BrightThorn and the Legion of Doom - Episode IV. \(The fate of the other episodes remains mysterious.\)
The second film in this double feature is a short documentary tour of Huntington Castle in Clonegal, Ireland - "Calling on Clonegal" paying a visit to bestselling author, mystic and priestess Lady Olivia Robertson, produced and directed by Ann Waters.
Filmmakers will be present for a chat after the screenings, and Egyptian popcorn will be provided. Come join us for a fun and peculiar afternoon in the beautiful Redwood temple theater at Isis Oasis Sanctuary!
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Addressing Homelessness: Lessons, Outcomes & Opportunities — Thu Sep 3, 8:15 AM — Bennett Valley Golf Course
item.description: The September 3 Wake Up with the Metro Chamber event will focus on homelessness as one of the region's most significant economic, public safety, humanitarian, and quality-of-life challenges. The goal is to create a practical, data-driven discussion around outcomes, accountability, and effective solutions. We’ll gain a better understanding of where resources are currently invested and what results those investments are producing, learn from successful models from other communities and regions, and explore what changes could produce better outcomes for individuals experiencing homelessness, taxpayers, businesses, and the broader community. 8:15–9:00 Coffee, Breakfast & Networking 9:00–10:30 Program featuring Nolan Sullivan, Health Services Agency Director, County of Sonoma and Sarah Fields, Deputy Director, Public Affairs | Housing Department, City of San José Tickets $45 member | $55 non-member by August 26 $55 member | $65 non-member after August 26 Table of 8 $375 member | $450 non-me
